A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] with distinctively long [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a beard in heavy braids served as one of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] '''false Prophets of the Dark Side'''.

==Biography==
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] established a mock religion known as the [[Church of the Dark Side]]. A clergy of con [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Prophets]] was constituted, including an elderly [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] with a long, braided beard. When the Prophets of the Dark Side gave shelter to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure|Zorba]], they honored him with a huge banquet in Scardia's formal dining hall. Like most members of the Church, the braid-bearded Prophet had a refined personality, and he was shocked by the Hutt's improper table manners.

All the false Prophets of the Dark Side, but one named [[Orloc]], were killed when [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Afsheen Makati|Makati]] [[Bombardment of Scardia Station|bombarded]] [[Scardia Station]].<ref name="ENDTSD" />
